$comment: sc-23001 (epic 22988): the YuE2 memory-profile cases the terminal story (sc-23002) captures ONCE, on Mac Metal and Windows CUDA, through scripts/yue2-memory-profile.mjs. YuE2 is an audio-lane model with no image five-rung contract, so it has its own profile harness rather than an anchor in config/memory-calibration-plan.json; it shares that harness's currency rule (the `candle:yue2` compile-closure digest in config/inference-provider-closures.json) and its Darwin footprint guard (scripts/memory-calibration-watchdog.py). Each case is `yue2:<tier>:<backend>:<request>`, expanded from `requests` x `backends`. A record is keyed by the exact model repo@revision + tier weights, the decoder repo@revision, the engine's closure digest, the tier and the backend; `check` grades a record whose identity no longer matches as stale and `ingest` refuses it. `run` skips every case the corpus already holds a current record for, so an interrupted campaign resumes instead of starting over. Nothing here runs in CI.

default.$comment: The product default: a planned (cot full) song at the engine's default ABC / semantic budgets, standard decoder, admission-chosen memory controls. One per tier: every advertised tier gets a measurement.

long-context.$comment: The memory worst case the protocol admits: no plan (cot off, so the whole context is song), guidance on (two semantic KV caches), and 16 000 forced semantic tokens — 640 s of audio, two acoustic chunks (a chunk is (24576 - prefix - 3) / 2 frames), the longest decode. q4 keeps the weights small so the working sets dominate.
